query: INSERT INTO portals.code_send (link_id, reserved_at, outcome) VALUES ($1, $2, 'pending') ON CONFLICT (link_id) DO UPDATE SET reserved_at = EXCLUDED.reserved_at, outcome = 'pending' WHERE portals.code_send.outcome = 'failed' OR (portals.code_send.outcome = 'pending' AND portals.code_send.reserved_at < $3) RETURNING link_id
